text:
noah (support): Escalating OrchidAI onboarding. Customer hit an ingest rate limit during data seeding and the dedicated workspace provisioning returned 403. Their renewal is ~21 days out; customer said they'll consider switching if onboarding stalls. Marking P0 for CS.
hannah (cs): Acknowledged. Can you paste the error text and any request IDs?
noah (support): Error in UI: "Provision failed (403) - tenant not authorized". Provisioner logs show `quota_exceeded` for ingestion and then `route_not_found` when creating workspace. Request IDs attached.
hannah (cs): Assigning @diego to own comms and @jin to triage the provisioner/ingest side. I'll loop in @oliver from sales if renewal looks in danger.
diego (cs): I'll draft a short update to the customer ASAP: hold message + ETA 30m.
jin (eng): Quick heads-up: looks like tenant `orchidai` consumed bursting tokens during seed job and hit ingress quota. When the seed job retried it tripped a race in the route binder leading to a missing tenant route -> 403. Reproduced locally. Plan: pause the seed, resequence the bind, and throttle the seed job. Running fix now: ``/opt/scripts/repair_bind.sh orchidai && systemctl restart seed-worker``
ops-bot: repair job started (job=rb-9002) for tenant orchidai
noah (support): After repair, some provisioning attempts still got 403 for ~40s then started returning 200. Customer reports partial success on dataset upload.
hannah (cs): Diego, please prepare a customer-facing note that explains root cause at a high level, actions we took, and what we'll monitor. Also propose a goodwill package (we discussed 1-hour onboarding assist + $500 credit) if they express frustration.
diego (cs): Draft to customer: "Hi Priya — thanks for your patience. We found two issues: your initial seed exceeded the ingestion burst quota and triggered a transient routing failure during workspace creation. We repaired the route binder and throttled the seed; uploads are now progressing. We'll monitor job success for 24 hours and will schedule a 1-hour onboarding assist + $500 account credit if you'd like. Please confirm when uploads finish and we'll help validate the workspace." Sending now.
marta (account): Noted — I'll log the offer in CRM and mark potential renewal risk as "watch" until onboarding completes.
jin (eng): I'll leave a log monitor for 4 hours: `journalctl -u provisioner -f | grep orchidai` and an alert on any 403 spikes.
noah (support): Customer replied: "Thanks — uploads finished and workspace ready. Appreciate the help; decline the credit for now"
diego (cs): Updating CRM: onboarding -> "Completed", renewal_risk -> "Cleared"; note: goodwill offered and declined. Adding short incident note: cause = ingest quota + race in route binder; remediation = resequence bind, throttle seed, add guardrail for quota spikes.
hannah (cs): Closing escalation. Action list: Diego finalize CRM + comms, Jin monitor 4h and add alert, Noah watch support ops, Hannah notify renewal lead and keep sales looped. Great response team :white_check_mark:
